known.via: English Wikipedia "Central Valley (wine region)" (redirects to "Central Valley (Chilean wine region)")

climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: Chile's main wine-growing zone, spanning O'Higgins, Maule and the Metropolitana region. It includes Maipo, Rapel, Curicó and Maule Valleys. Cabernet Sauvignon covers 34 percent of its vines, with Sauvignon Blanc, Merlot and Carmenère behind.
